title: Expert queue
subtitle: What negotiators have flagged, oldest first. Each item is closed with its outcome.

forbidden.scope: Review Guide Négo knowledge, across the whole platform
forbidden.description: The expert queue is reserved for Guide Négo experts. Writing or publishing knowledge does not give access to it.

reports.title: No pending reports
reports.description: Answers reported as outdated or wrong will appear here.

questions.title: No question is waiting.
questions.description: Questions asked to the experts from Guide Négo will appear here, oldest first.

proposals.title: No suggested term is waiting.
proposals.description: Terms suggested from Guide Négo will appear here, oldest first.

fromFeedback: From “Was this answer helpful?” — Outdated or wrong

reason.source_mismatch: The source does not say that

close.label: Close:
close.title: Close this report?

question.revised: The answer has been corrected: the report will be closed with this outcome.
question.confirmed: The answer is still correct: the report will be closed with this outcome.
question.dismissed: The report calls for no action: it will be dismissed.

close.notice: Closing a report does not change the entry. To correct it or mark it “To review”, open the entry.

answer.label: Your answer
answer.hint: The person who asked receives an email; the answer can be read in “My questions”.
answer.title: Answer sent
answer.done: Answer sent. The person who asked has been notified by email.

promote.noConsent: The person who asked did not agree to it joining the FAQ.
promote.title: Promote this question to the FAQ?
promote.question: A FAQ draft will be created in the chosen section, with this question and its answer.
promote.notice: The draft will carry no name and no account. Rewrite it before publishing: the question and answer are taken as they were written.
promote.done: FAQ draft created. Rewrite it before publishing.

proposal.authors: Suggested by {count} person | Suggested by {count} people
proposal.nearbyNone: No close entry in the glossary.
proposal.open: Open the entry born from the suggestion

reject.label: Reason for rejection
reject.hint: It stays on record; the people who suggested the term are not notified.

page.title: Define “{term}”
page.intro: The form creates the entry as a draft. The people who suggested the term receive an email when it is published.
